headline: Technical Review Committee to review subdivisions on Point Avenue, Walmsley Lane, and a 275-unit Lofts on Fairgrounds development.
summary: The committee will give advisory review to administrative subdivisions on Point Avenue and Walmsley Lane, a minor subdivision for David LaPorte, and a preliminary plan for a 275-unit multi-family development called Lofts on Fairgrounds at 132 Fairgrounds Road.
items: Advisory review of Point Avenue Administrative Subdivision to recombine and reconfigure property boundaries at 62A, 62B, & 76 Point Ave (AP 82-4, Lots 28, 29, 30); Laurie Keene of Keene Architecture Inc., applicant; Daniel and Susan Cromie and the Susan E. Cromie Revocable Trust, owners

Advisory review of Walmsley Lane Administrative Subdivision to reconfigure property boundaries at 35 Walmsley Lane and 40 Lacey Lane (AP 27-1, Lot 12 and AP 19-4, Lot 4); Eric Prive of DiPrete Engineering, applicant; Gerald and Loretta Petros, and Barry Bellino, owners
Advisory review of LaPorte Minor Subdivision for Administrative Officer approval at AP 68-2, Lot 18; David LaPorte, applicant/owner

Preliminary plan review (Comprehensive Permit) for Lofts on Fairgrounds, a proposed six-building, 275-unit multi-family development with an amenity building at 132 Fairgrounds Road (Assessor's Plat 21-3, Lot 9); 132 Fairgrounds, LLC, applicant/owner
location: South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on October 8, 2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Technical Review Committee (TRC)  
Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, October 14, 2026 at 9:00 AM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
 
  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 1. September 9, 2026 
C. TRC Review: 
D. TRC Advisory Review: 
 1. Point Avenue Administrative Subdivision – Advisory review of an Administrative Subdivision to recombine 
and reconfigure the property boundaries on the subject site located at 62A, 62B, & 76 Point Ave (AP 82-4, 
Lots 28, 29, 30), Laurie Keene of Keene Architecture Inc., applicant; Daniel and Susan Cromie and the Susan 
E. Cromie Revocable Trust, owners.  
 2. Walmsley Lane Administrative Subdivision – Advisory review of an Administrative Subdivision to 
reconfigure the property boundaries on the subject site located at 35 Walmsley Lane and 40 Lacey Lane (AP 
27-1, Lot 12 and AP 19-4, Lot 4), Eric Prive of DiPrete Engineering, applicant; Gerald and Loretta Petros, and 
Barry Bellino, owners.  
 3. LaPorte Minor Subdivision - Advisory review of a Minor Subdivision for Administrative Officer approval.  AP 
68-2, Lot 18.  David LaPorte, applicant/owner. 
 4. Major Land Development, Preliminary Plan Review (Comprehensive Permit) — Lofts on Fairgrounds 
Proposed six (6) building multi-family development with an amenity building at the entrance. Each building 
provides a mixture of studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units for a total of 275 residential units and 
associated site improvements. Located at 132 Fairgrounds Road on Assessor's Plat 21-3, Lot 9. 132 
Fairgrounds, LLC, applicant/owner. 
  
E. Adjournment:
